queue.title: Basket weave 12x24 Tile, here's how, and what can go wrong. #tile #basketweave
queue.description:
SUBSCRIBE Learn how to tile the right way.
Basket weave 12x24 Tile, here's how, and what can go wrong. Basket Weave, Double stacked or basket Pattern, not exactly sure what the pattern is called. This is a time lapse of a 12"x 24" Rectified Modular large format porcelain tile installed on Schluter Ditra XL uncoupling membrane
The Tile Pattern consists of two tiles stacked and turned in alternate directions to form large squares of two tiles each. The tiles used to create this pattern must either be modular or have the long side exactly equal to twice the short side including the appropriate grout line width. The tiles in this video were Modular, and also rectified to allow for a very narrow grout line. Generally, cheaper tiles with poor calibration will be difficult to install in a pattern as it will be difficult to keep them  aligned, causing the corners of the tile to run off and result in an unappealing outcome with mismatched corners. It is of critical importance to keep the tiles straight and square to not run into problems with fitting the tiles into the pattern. All tile installed by Sal DiBlasi, Elite-tile Company, in the Boston North Shore area.
